isPublic.description: Whether the note is visible to the customer. Defaults to false.

delta.description: Amount to add (positive) or remove (negative) from stock on hand.

cancelShipping.description: Also cancel shipping charges. Defaults to true.

method.description: Shipping method or carrier name to record on the fulfillment.

trackingCode.description: The carrier's tracking code for this shipment.

orderLineId.description: Order line ID, as returned by get_order.

quantity.description: How many of that line to fulfill, a whole number of at least 1.

lines.description: Lines to fulfill. Omit to fulfill every line in the quantity still unfulfilled.

state.description: Move the new fulfillment straight to this state. Shipped makes the order Shipped or PartiallyShipped; Delivered makes it Delivered or PartiallyDelivered.

translations.description: Localized product content. At least one entry with a languageCode is required.

optionIds.description: Product option IDs for this variant.

id.description: Order ID. Pass this or code, not both.

code.description: Order code, used when ID is omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.
Maximum number of customer groups to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

offset.description: Number of customer groups to skip.

limit.description: Maximum number of customers to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

contains.description: Substring match. Case-insensitive on Postgres, otherwise follows the database's collation.

postalCode.description: Matches the postal code of any of the customer's addresses.

filter.description: Conditions a customer must meet; all of them apply together. Example: {"emailAddress":{"eq":"jane@example.com"}} finds the customer with that email.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

contains.description: Substring match. Case-insensitive on Postgres, otherwise follows the database's collation.
Substring match. Case-insensitive on Postgres, otherwise follows the database's collation.

state.description: Order state, for example PaymentSettled or ArrangingPayment.

active.description: true for open carts, false for placed or cancelled orders.

contains.description: Substring match. Case-insensitive on Postgres, otherwise follows the database's collation.

totalWithTax.description: Whole number in the currency's smallest unit, like every price these tools return.

filter.description: Conditions an order must meet; all of them apply together. Example: {"state":{"eq":"ArrangingPayment"},"updatedAt":{"before":"2026-08-25T12:00:00Z"}} finds orders stuck at payment since before noon.

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to orderPlacedAt, which lists the most recently placed orders first. Orders that are still open carts have no orderPlacedAt and sort last.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

contains.description: Substring match. Case-insensitive on Postgres, otherwise follows the database's collation.

Substring match. Case-insensitive on Postgres, otherwise follows the database's collation.

sku.description: Matches any of the product's variant SKUs. The result lists products, not variants, so it does not show which variant matched.

filter.description: Conditions a product must meet; all of them apply together. Example: {"sku":{"contains":"L2201"}} finds the product a variant SKU belongs to.

amount.description: Amount to refund in minor units. Defaults to the selected payment's remaining refundable amount.

paymentId.description: Payment to refund; must belong to this order. Defaults to the order's first Settled payment that still has a refundable amount.

channelToken.description: Channel token of the channel to activate.

optionIds.description: Product option IDs for this variant.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL of the asset to fetch and store.

variantId.description: Product variant ID, taken from the variants listed by get_product. Give this or productId, not both.

productId.description: Product ID, as returned by search_products or get_product. Never pass a variant ID here. Use this only when the product has a single variant; if it has several, the call is refused and the variants are listed so you can pass one as variantId instead.

quantity.description: Quantity, a whole number of at least 1.

slug.description: Collection slug, used when ID is omitted.
Product slug, used when ID is omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

parentId.description: Return the children of this collection.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

paymentMetadata.description: Metadata passed to the payment handler.

query.description: Text to look up in product names and slugs.

collectionId.description: Only products in this collection. Take the id from list_collections or get_collection.

collectionSlug.description: Only products in this collection. Take the slug from list_collections or get_collection.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

billingSameAsShipping.description: Use the shipping address as the billing address too. Copies shippingAddress from this call, or the shipping address already on the cart. Cannot be combined with billingAddress.

customer.description: Who is buying, for a guest checkout. Not needed when the caller is a signed-in customer.

quantity.description: New quantity for the line, a whole number. 0 removes the line.
